title: How do skill versions relate to Workbench releases?
question: How do skill versions relate to Workbench releases?
answer:
V3-8: The checked-out LLM Workbench release owns the bundled versions. Normal setup is presence-only; an explicitly authorized skill update backs up changed destinations and synchronizes the required core to the exact bundled versions.
V3-8A: No. No separate release dependency is required; the bundled skill sources version with LLM Workbench.
V3-8B: Yes, so no second repository or publication gate is required.
V3-13C: Together in the same LLM Workbench v3 candidate so no external skills-repository dependency exists.
REC-03: Bump to v3.1.3: freeze v3.1.2 at sixteen in supportedLegacy and set the room's manifest to v3.1.3.
